Description: Survey Studio adds a full survey builder to the Umbraco backoffice, built on SurveyJS - no separate SurveyJS license required. Editors design multi-page surveys, quizzes, and data-capture forms with reusable custom question types, data lists, themes, and translations, drive branching logic with conditional rules, and trigger workflows - email notifications, webhooks, or custom actions - when a submission completes. Forms are organized into folders and reusable templates, and submissions are reviewed and exported to CSV right in the backoffice.
